notes: Group g6 = caching-memoization (16), data-structures (52), persistence-durability (29). Bridging rule: 95/97 elements carry >=1 cross-realm realizes/enables edge (or are a constrains target: fixed-capacity-container via time-and-space-partitioning, mirroring the mission's ARINC-653 calibration example); 2 unbridged (erase-remove, zipper). Same-name pair bridged: event-sourcing realizes event-sourcing-architecture-style. Deliberate NON-bridge: design 'repository' (PoEAA/DDD) and arch 'repository-shared-data-style' (Shaw-Garlan shared-data style) are homonyms naming different concepts - not bridged as a pair. MISSING arch targets found (demand-driven growth candidates): (1) a DBMS-internal 'access method / index manager' component element - b-tree, lsm-tree, r-tree, secondary-index currently target the whole relational-dbms-reference-architecture; (2) a 'caching tier / distributed cache' architecture pattern - the many cache-strategy elements all land on the Bass maintain-multiple-copies-of-data tactic; (3) an 'algorithmic efficiency' family more specific than increase-resource-usage-efficiency - 21 pure-algorithmic structures target that tactic as their only defensible arch endpoint (it is the correct Bass tactic for algorithm/data-structure selection, but a finer-grained target would sharpen the map); (4) a text-editor/document-application reference architecture (gap-buffer, piece-table, rope); (5) entity-component-system as an architecture-level organization (slot-map, sparse-set); (6) a search-engine reference architecture (inverted-index, suffix-array); (7) an embedded nonvolatile-storage/parameter-persistence element and a wear/lifetime-management element (eeprom-emulation, flash-wear-leveling currently on adaptor-connector and exception-prevention). Provenance discipline: sourced only where the relation itself is stated (Bass tactic definitions naming mechanisms, PoEAA pattern pairings, DDIA prose, POSA2, Nystrom see-also/realizations, primary papers: Pugh, Huet, Bagwell, Nakamoto, Dynamo, Chord, Deutsch-Schiffman, ARIES, Gray, Fowler bliki/LMAX, Azure Index Table).
